summary: The grain is what comes from the threshing floor. An abundant harvest can feed a household and supply a tithe. Psalm 4 pairs grain and new wine when speaking of gladness.

senses.definition: The grain comes from the threshing floor. It can be stored, tithed or lent, and is often named beside wine and oil as produce of the land.

senses.gloss: grain as a measure of plenty
senses.definition: Isaac blesses Jacob with plentiful grain and wine. David measures his gladness against the joy of a rich harvest.

note: The biblical noun does not identify a particular cereal. The similar name Dagon belongs to the Philistine god in Judges 16:23. That verse gives no derivation of the name.
